note: contract 'ordo:NAME' = Ordo examples/ecir/consumer/NAME at e6fe390; otherwise a fixture in this directory (authored for REL-001 where Ordo's corpus lacks the case). deemedValid is the experiment's classification, fixed before any case ran. invalidityLayer: 'contract' = the contract alone is invalid (Ordo admission should refuse); 'reference' = the contract is self-consistent but the work authority references it wrongly (only Praxis can refuse); 'workflow' = valid ecir/1, but completing the named requirement is invalid.

cases.name: B2a-nonexistent-decision-in-contract
